headline: 14 arrested after fresh attack on New Gini Properties housing project
summary: Police detained 14 people following a brawl involving up to 150 armed individuals at the South Manikdi project in Dhaka.
details: Police have arrested 14 people following a fresh brawl at the New Gini Properties housing project in Dhaka’s South Manikdi on Saturday afternoon.
According to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP), between 100 and 150 people armed with local weapons entered the project area and engaged in a fight.
Three of those arrested sustained serious injuries and were moved from Kurmitola Multicare Specialized Hospital to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.
Cantonment police intervened to bring the situation under control and detained the suspects.
This follows a previous attack on September 26, where the project was vandalized and looted over a similar dispute.
The earlier attack also targeted the 'Brownfish' studio of content creator Salman Muqtadir, which is based within the project.
A case was filed at Cantonment Police Station naming 13 people, including retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury, and 150 to 200 unidentified others.
While 11 people were previously arrested for the September 26 incident, eight of them have since been released on bail.
caption:
14 arrested after 100-150 armed people stormed a housing project in Dhaka. This is the second such attack in less than a month.

Cantonment police intervened to bring the situation under control and detained the suspects.

This follows a previous attack on September 26, where the project was vandalized and looted over a similar dispute.

The earlier attack also targeted the 'Brownfish' studio of content creator Salman Muqtadir, which is based within the project.

A case was filed at Cantonment Police Station naming 13 people, including retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury, and 150 to 200 unidentified others.

While 11 people were previously arrested for the September 26 incident, eight of them have since been released on bail.

headline_marked: 1,674 hospitalised as [[three more die of dengue]] in 24 hours
headline: 1,674 hospitalised as three more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: The total death toll has risen to 458, with over 1.47 lakh cumulative cases reported across Bangladesh.
details: At least three dengue patients died and 1,674 others were hospitalised in a 24-hour period, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
The deaths were reported in the Dhaka and Barishal divisions, with two fatalities occurring in Dhaka and one in Barishal.
With these latest deaths, the total death toll from dengue has risen to 458, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,47,580.
Currently, 5,826 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across the country.
caption:
3 more deaths and 1,674 hospitalisations in just 24 hours. Dengue continues to surge across Bangladesh.

At least three dengue patients died and 1,674 others were hospitalised in a 24-hour period, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

The deaths were reported in the Dhaka and Barishal divisions, with two fatalities occurring in Dhaka and one in Barishal.

With these latest deaths, the total death toll from dengue has risen to 458, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,47,580.

Currently, 5,826 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across the country.
